name: Kinetic Poster
why: A fast, confident pitch: the words themselves are the picture, slammed in on the beat like a poster that keeps changing.
look: Full-colour grounds (red, black, yellow, blue) hard-cut on every new word group; one or two huge Archivo Black words at a time filling the width; the camera always pushes, shaking on the hits. Ends on cream with the whole last line.
elements: a clip strip with a waveform that gets cut
motion: Words land on the frame they are said; key words slam from 1.25x with a camera shake; grounds hard-cut; a constant slow push.
